data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this genuine resale of an ultra-luxury 2-bedroom corner apartment in the highly anticipated Jumeirah Emirates Towers Residences, located within the prestigious Emirates Towers District.

Developed by Meraas and managed by the world-renowned Jumeirah Group, this branded residence represents the pinnacle of luxury living in Dubai's financial hub. Positioned on a prime corner layout, this residence features floor-to-ceiling windows boasting panoramic views of the city skyline, high-end designer finishes, and exclusive access to Jumeirah’s signature 5-star hospitality services.

Key Property Features:

·Layout: Premium Corner Unit with Open-Plan Living & Dining Area

·Kitchen: Designer Semi-Closed Kitchen (Fully Equipped with Premium Finishes)

·Technology: Integrated Smart Home Automation System

·Parking: Private Covered Car Parking Spaces

Elite Branded Amenities & Services

·Sky Level: Private Sky Garden, Infinity Sky Pool, and Fitness & Wellness Club

·Leisure & Entertainment: Outdoor Cinema, Game Room, Co-Working Lounge, and Event Terrace

·Family & Sports: Kids Pool, Splash Playground, Family Pool, Pocket Garden, and Paddle Court

·Dining: Ground-Level Fine Dining Restaurants & Retail Boutique Strip

·Services: Jumeirah Signature Concierge & Housekeeping Services

Prime Connectivity & Location Highlights:

·05 Mins: One Central / DIFC

·07 Mins: The Dubai Mall & Downtown Dubai

·10 Mins: City Walk

·15 Mins: Dubai Design District (d3)

·17 Mins: J1 Beach (La Mer)

·20 Mins: Bulgari Resort Dubai

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a branded Jumeirah asset in a historically low-supply, high-demand district.

For the latest construction updates, payment plan breakdown, or to secure this genuine resale, contact me today.
